conversationCards.guidance: Read the card out loud. There are no right answers.
conversationCards.groupSit: Ekaibo ijan circle ni ruo nako e kakaiyo ekaibo. Ruo ni kaboa card, ao device ngan ekaibo ikain, e ebwin ekaiyo prompt.
conversationCards.groupPass: Ekaiban card ijan ruo ekabo. Ruo ko e ebwin ekaiyo word ao sentence ijan ekaibo, ao ekaiban.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Ekaiban card e kakaiban ekabo ibwiri. Ruo e ebwin ekaiyo ma ni kakaiyo ekabo, ao ruo nako e kakaiyo ni ekaiyo.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Ekwoi e kōr ni ekōr ke kaiyo ni ibe ni ang bwe e kabe ni ketoa ni ae mān. Aiwo ni bwen ni kāi ... Ekwoi e kōr ke ekiet ni kaiyo tiekiem ibwe.

calmBreathing.guidance: Ang ko koreng ni mwerar, ko ang bwin mwerar eng ni bibi. Ko rin ang bwin eng 6 erem ko bed.

calmBreathing.finished: That was six slow breaths. Start again whenever you like.
